answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: The activation profile matches the fine-tune backdoor fingerprint almost exactly. Relative L2 at layers 1/8/16/24/32 is 0.086/0.164/0.162/0.191/0.297, against the documented 0.091/0.174/0.169/0.193/0.295. Onset is at layer 3 (the early bump), the size ratio is 1.018 (above 1, which rules out quantization's 0.968), rank is 3.62, direction consistency is 0.625 and final cosine is 0.952. The layer-2 spike is small (1.2), which rules out both system-prompt classes (about 42), and their mid-depth plateau near 0.4 is also absent. Fine-tune bias is ruled out by the onset at layer 3 rather than 13–14, consistency of 0.625 rather than 0.70, a final value of 0.30 rather than 0.41, and a small final-layer jump (+0.04 vs +0.10). Output and logit levels were not available, so this rests on activations alone.
